description: This file contains a class 'SlugifyParameterTransformer' which implements the 'IOutboundParameterTransformer' interface to transform route parameters into a URL-friendly slug format by inserting hyphens and converting to lowercase.

classes.name: SlugifyParameterTransformer
classes.description: A class that transforms route parameter objects into URL slugs by applying regex replacements.

methods.name: TransformOutbound
methods.description: Transforms the input value into a URL slug by replacing camel case boundaries with hyphens and converting to lowercase.
